deletedHistoricalContext.text: As an explicit extension of the closed stage-operation set in Section 14.6, an existing stage may expose EXECUTE_FAILURE_TEST or EXECUTE_REGRESSION for a current accepted failure-test or regression definition when that stage is later than the definition's owning stage, its EARLIEST_EXECUTABLE_STAGE has been reached, and its current target-availability condition and mandatory phase targets are TRUE. The stage is the selected execution stage in the active project version. This extension does not make subsequent-stage material available to an earlier-stage handoff. The registry contains these conditional combinations; it does not accept arbitrary operation names or infer permissions from a response.
